_how_to_use: Controls which /software/<slug>/ product pages Google may index. Every product page stays live and linked; pages not released get <meta name="robots" content="noindex,follow"> and are left out of sitemap.xml. A page is indexable if its slug is in always_index or release_for_indexing, OR (auto_index_verified is true AND data/vendor-verified.json has a checked price_text, price_source and price_note for it). Slugs in hold_noindex are always noindexed (overrides everything). To release more pages later (drip-feed), add their slugs to release_for_indexing and rebuild.
